isolation: Index only. Do not store a merged Nigeria lexicon here. Naija is a separate dataset under this folder. Do not copy Ghanaian Pidgin or Krio.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.

missing_term.message: Query a named language folder under data/nigeria_dataset/. A merged Nigeria lexicon is not stored at this path.

license.source_extracts: Cited academic sources retain their original terms. See each language sources.md.

extraction_notes: Parent index of Nigeria languages. Lexicon is stored only in the language folders, and only from sources that name that language.
